items: Changing the soldiers' level (`EncSoldierImperialTemplate` 01FC5D, through `EncSoldierSonsTemplate` 027498) also needs the CC `ccFFBSSE001_NPC_StormcloakChampion` 00086C · `…Backup` 000957 (PC×1 [10–35]) and `ccFFBSSE001_KlijaBaseBountyFixChampion` 00095D (PC×1.25 [20–60]), all ccffbsse001-imperialdragon.esl (on *Named Stormcloaks*): they use `EncSoldierSonsTemplate` as template but not for `Stats`; and the Sovngarde lost souls `MQ304LostSoulSons` 090A47 · `…2` 0173C0 · `…3` 0173C2 (PC×1.5 [3–20]; on the leaves M03, M01, M02 without `Stats`; listed as never met on the *Stormcloaks* group page). `EncGuardSonsTemplate` 0F6F38 also uses 027498 without `Stats`, but is a row of its own. The same owner also carries the Imperial soldiers, so the Imperial-side records that keep their own level under it are listed on *Common Legion*.

Changing `EncGuardSonsTemplate` 0F6F38 also needs `MQ301SonsSoldier` 046EFD (the Stormcloak casualty of Odahviing's capture, PC×1.5 [3–20]; listed as never met on the *Stormcloaks* group page): it takes its template from `GuardWhiterunSonsPatrolDay`, a wrapper on `LCharGuardSons`, which draws the guard leaves, without `Stats`.

The two mages' level 6 is owned by `EncWarlock02TemplateIce` 045C60 (on Warlocks → *Cryomancers*). Changing it also needs `EncWarlock02TemplateBossIce` 0E0FC0 (7, on *Warlock Bosses*), which uses it as template but not for `Stats`, and six CC records that take their template from `LvlWarlockElemental`, which draws it, without `Stats`: the Almsivi `ccASVSSE001_ElderDrevlan`, `…CaretakerIneril`, `…Priest02`, `…Priest03`, `…PriestDrureth` (on *Ghosts of the Tribunal*) and `ccBGSSSE013_GreenGuardian` 000845:ccbgssse013-dawnfang.esl.
The other rows: no other record keeps its own level (`dunCGStormcloakTowerA` uses `MQ101StormcloakPrisonerMale` as template without `Stats`, but shares the Helgen row at the same level).

Every other record that looks like a row (the `CWFort*`, `CWSiege*`, `CWSoldierSons*`, `MQ103` and `CW` mission wrappers, the garrison and hold guards, every `Lvl*` wrapper, and the records moved here from Uncategorised: `CWPrisonerSonsB`/`C`, the `GuardWhiterunSons*` and `GuardWindhelmSonsPatrol*` wrappers) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
